directories.description: Selected local directory paths. Supports absolute paths, paths relative to the daemon working directory, and ~/ paths. No directories are scanned until configured.

recursive.description: Scan subdirectories recursively. Nested symbolic links are always skipped.

ignoreHidden.description: Skip files and directories whose names start with a dot.

ignoredDirectories.description: Directory basenames to skip at any depth, compared case-insensitively.

fileExtensions.description: File extensions to scan, with or without a leading dot. An empty list asks installed processors about every regular file; unsupported files are skipped.

maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum file size in MiB; larger files report an error and remain eligible for retry.

processingTimeoutMs.description: Timeout per document or image processing request, in milliseconds.

embeddingBatchSize.description: Maximum number of chunks in each embedding request.

forceAll.description: Reprocess selected files even when their recorded versions are unchanged.

namespace.description: Namespace for directory entities and source graph claims.
